description: The shell exit status: 0 behaves like a ping, 1-255 record the code as a failure. `curl -fsS $ORIGIN/in/ID/$?` at the end of a script is the whole integration. `0` behaves exactly like a plain ping; 1 to 255 record the code and leave the failure for the cron.

exit_code.description: Exit status, 0 to 255. Outside that range it is a 400.

name: signal_exit_code
title: Signal exit code
